component: P04-13 LibraryWindow private preference precedence, Save capture/request/ack and queue lifecycle

finding.description: Unaccepted/no-owner save could receive a direct Reload or saved-view request while activeColumnSave blocked scheduling, then clear active with only updateActions. No later event was guaranteed to dispatch the newly pending request. Synchronous ack path had the analogous scheduling omission.
finding.reproduction: Valid Primary baseline; saveRequested direct receiver triggers Reload while no Bridge accepts and Window stays idle; pending read must subsequently dispatch without another unrelated action.
finding.correction: Both post-save-dispatch and matching save-ack paths now call queueSavedServices and queueColumnLayouts before updateActions; existing mutual active/busy/closing gates preserve accepted busy work and only schedule when safe.
finding.regression: Root added reloadQueuedInsideRejectedSaveRequestStillDispatches; source reviewer did not execute it.

reviewed_properties: Private preferences apply in preference to original per-pane layout only when the entire native DTO validates, raw snapshot/source are owned/valid and matching session/latest request plus captured per-pane edit revision remain current. Private absent uses existing six-ID original import; malformed/unsupported read cannot silently fall back or enable Save.

Save availability is granted only by an accepted current Primary read; session changes and new reload clear it, failed/no-result saves clear it and require reload. Recovery/Missing/Failed/incomplete packets cannot permit Save. File baselines stay worker-owned and never arrive as editable GUI authority.

Save is explicit and idle-only, refuses zero/exhausted session/counters and outstanding read/pending read/save; captures both immutable complete catalogue panes and current revisions, validates DTO, increments bounded save ID and sets active before public submission signal. QPointer handles result-slot deletion; failed dispatch clears only matching active save when no synchronous busy acceptance.

Acknowledgment requires exact active session/save request, then clears only that active save. It changes no widgets/header/model/selection/filter/details/revision. Successful older capture reports newer local edits remain unsaved; unchanged capture gets success message. It never marks a newer revision clean or imports the stored capture. Failure disables retry until a new baseline read.

Reload can coalesce while Save is busy; services/read/save markers mutually gate dispatch. Newest pending read survives accepted save and no-packet completion; corrected rejected/synchronous-ack paths also schedule it. Busyfalse clears missing result without inventing success and resumes the existing normal details path.

Close/session changes drop pending/active presentation authority as appropriate; late old IDs cannot retarget new session, and close/reopen retained My Torrents is unchanged. Save completion during closing may update truthful status only; it cannot apply layout, reattach/focus the page or dispatch backend controls.

Source comparison verifies25 complete prior Window definitions unchanged including CtrlW navigation, source selection, snapshot/telemetry/details and transfer-target methods. New action/capture/ack do not add automatic writes, generic Refresh imports, payload/network access, registered-Java defaults or live rank semantics.
